title: You cant use a platform that profits off racial hate, is used to suppress minority votes and whose leadership team will resort to antisemitic attacks
summary: You cant use a platform that profits off racial hate, is used to suppress minority votes and whose leadership team will resort to antisemitic attacks to get their way in Congress to then fight racial hate. Might as well join Republican Party to fight climate change
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
You cant use a platform that profits off racial hate, is used to suppress minority votes and whose leadership team will resort to antisemitic attacks to get their way in Congress to then fight racial hate.

Might as well join Republican Party to fight climate change
